title: GET|POST /api/v1/verify/labels
description: How far the tenant's gold set has formed (m1_021 gold_set_members, 06 §5.1): every strong label, the human ones among them, the open (accumulating) set, the latest frozen snapshot a certificate cites, and the two gates (§5.3 bootstrapping at 50, D15 certified at 200).
